### What does this PR do?

Adds [Awesome-Perception-Aware-RLVR](https://github.com/zsxm1998/awesome-perception-aware-rlvr) to "Awesome Projects Built with `verl`" in README.md (one line, after the last entry).

The project is built on EasyR1 (a verl fork). It implements 19 perception-aware RLVR and on-policy distillation methods for vision-language models in one codebase, trains most of them in two controlled comparisons (RLVR on Qwen3-VL-4B, OPD on a Qwen3-VL-2B student), and provides one-click evaluation on 30+ multimodal benchmarks.

### Checklist Before Starting

- [x] Search for similar PRs. Paste at least one query link here: https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pulls?q=is%3Apr+perception-aware
- [x] Format the PR title as `[{modules}] {type}: {description}` (This will be checked by the CI)

### Test

Documentation only (one line in README.md); no code change.

### Checklist Before Submitting

- [x] Read the [Contribute Guide](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] Apply pre-commit checks: not applicable, README only.
- [ ] Add / Update the documentation: this PR is the documentation change.
- [ ] Add unit or end-to-end test(s): not feasible, documentation only.
